formulae.untruncated_rowgroup_covariance: Cov(W z_i + b | source row i assigned to nearest target center) + kernel covariance; independent kernel noise
formulae.warning: Untruncated source-row-group covariance is not the gate covariance. Conditioning on generated point radius or nearest-center assignment changes noise/location dependence. A component-mean radius filter is not generated-point conditioning.

limitations: No random samples, images, training, critic gradient/Hessian probes or source changes.
Only final checkpoint supplies exact affine/location geometry; earlier saved output clouds cannot separate generator and prior state.
Filtering component means by evaluator radius does not condition generated kernel draws, and source-row group assignment differs from output assignment for remote components.
Per-mode descriptive comparisons do not define additional gates or replace original FAIL verdicts.
Within-radius covariance deficits cannot be uniquely causally attributed to kernel or locations by additive untruncated covariance.
One screening seed and one native task; no robustness or complete-reference-positive claim.
next_structural_question: Does the saved critic/prior response hold most component means in tight within-mode clusters while letting a minority broaden or drift? Inspect deterministic critic radial gradients or public prior-update residual moments on the existing state before registering a new mechanism. Keep sigma, initializer, gates and serving law fixed; no winner, amplitude or singular-value search.
